But before any of that, you answer the question the whole platform is built around: what are the records, what do they contain, and how do they relate?

questions.question: Which conclusion does the lesson support?
options: Sharing rules protect records, Flows act on records, reports aggregate records, integrations move records.

Master-detail. "Closely links objects together such that the master record controls certain behaviors of the detail and subdetail record." Concretely: deleting a master also deletes related detail records; the detail's Owner field isn't available (ownership is inherited from the master); and detail records inherit the master's security and permissions, so you can't set permissions on the detail independently.
